items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzg0NzQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--e6240fd13450938c58ea02a2948e07de0e818fb2/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)

## *IMPORTANT: This competition will be hosting a Dual Round for the first and second rounds of 3x3x3 cube. Please see the [DUAL ROUND!](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BurnabyHandWarmers2027#81477-dual-round) tab for more information.*

To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz).
You are also welcome to join the Facebook group
[Rubik's Cube Solvers British Columbia](https://www.facebook.com/groups/8336572494).

**Time Zone Reminder for U.S. Competitors: Effective November 2026, British Columbia will remain on daylight saving time year-round. As such, Vancouver will be one hour ahead of Washington state on the date of this competition. Please account for this time difference when planning your travel!**

Please **review all of the tabs on this website**. You **only need to show up for events that you're competing in**, but we encourage you to stay longer. Note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly in the afternoon — **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. An email with information and reminders will be sent a few days before the competition.

**Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media, and other digital platforms.

items.name: Erlangen Open V 2027
items.information:
Erlangen Open V 2027 is open to every citizen from every nation.

Bitte beachtet: Die Venue ist neben einer Kirche mit Glocken. Wenn ihr Empfindlich bei Störungen seid, achtet bitte auf Gehörschutz.
Please note: The venue is located next to a church with bells. If you are sensitive to noise, please consider bringing hearing protection.

items.name: Forget Nothing Redondo Beach 2027

venue.name: Redondo Beach Main Public Library
venue.address: 303 N Pacific Coast Hwy Redondo Beach, CA 90277

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/forgetnothingredondobeach2027#17574-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/)

items.name: Monaco Open 2027
items.information:
This will be the first official WCA competition in the Principality of Monaco!

The fastest competitor from Monaco in 3x3 event will be crowned national champion of Monaco.
